info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Fraud Resolution Submission API
info.description: The Fraud Resolution Submission API enables businesses to efficiently submit resolutions related to fraud findings in their banking operations. This endpoint allows users to report incidents, providing essential details for compliance and risk management. Typical consumers include compliance officers and fraud analysts who need to document fraudulent cases and track their resolution processes. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their operational efficiency in managing fraud-related issues.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new resolution for fraud cases, ensuring that necessary details are captured accurately to facilitate effective resolution management.
